page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E5.Flex.64-512 is a general-purpose virtual machine configuration based on the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9J14 processor. The instance provides 64 dedicated physical cores with simultaneous multithreading, exposing 128 virtual CPUs running at a base clock frequency of 2.3 GHz. System memory totals 512.0 GB, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per thread.

The instance does not include integrated GPU accelerators and features no local NVMe or disk storage, requiring external block storage for operating system drives and persistent storage needs. Network connectivity incorporates one complimentary public IPv4 address. Because the compute resources are assigned via dedicated CPU allocation rather than shared-core scheduling, instruction throughput remains consistent across all active threads.

With its 128 vCPU density and balanced memory footprint, VM.Standard.E5.Flex.64-512 functions efficiently for enterprise application hosting, large-scale continuous integration and compilation, batch data processing, and multi-tenant web application tiers that require broad horizontal scaling without specialized local disk acceleration.
